# The first day and the length of every Jalali year from 1300 to 1499, as ICU computes them.
#
# Format: <jalali year> <gregorian date of 1 Farvardin> <days in the year>
#
# Generated on 2026-10-13 by asking ICU 78.3's Persian calendar, as shipped with Node 24.18.0
# (`Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-u-ca-persian-nu-latn")`), for the Persian date of every day from
# 1921-01-01 to 2122-12-31 and recording each 1 Farvardin. Nothing in this repository computed
# these values; that is the point of them. `tests/backend/test_jalali.py` holds
# `app/core/jalali.py` to every line, so the rule there cannot change without this file saying so.
#
# A second independent description — Borkowski's break-table algorithm, the one jalaali-js
# implements — was compared against this table when the window was chosen and agreed on all 200
# years. Agreement outside 1300-1499 was not measured, which is why the converter refuses it.
